text:
sam: Heads-up — NebulaX reported being charged twice for the March renewal. They pasted two receipts. Looks like both a midnight billing batch and a late PO attach fired. filing ticket #NX-2026-312 :unamused:
maria: Ticket NX-2026-312 created. Customer says invoices INV-2026-03A and INV-2026-03B both show paid. They need immediate reversal on the duplicate. Customer contact: support@nebulax.io. :phone:
jon: digging into billing logs now. I see batch-charge job ran at 00:00:00 UTC, processed subscriptions for March. PO webhook for NebulaX arrived at 00:00:03 and our PO-attach flow triggered a second invoice creation at 00:00:04 — looks like we allow a grace window that caused a duplicate invoice to be created and auto-paid. :thinking_face:
sam: ugh. so both charges captured, different invoice IDs but same period. Any tax/VAT difference? Customer is EU — VAT handling matters for reversal process.
jon: invoice INV-2026-03A (00:00:00) tax computed as VAT exempt via old customer flag. INV-2026-03B (00:00:04) applied updated EU VAT rate 20% because the PO include country info. So they were charged different amounts. That explains the customer's confusion.
maria: I've messaged NebulaX and asked for last4 and bank timestamp, they confirmed two separate charges. They asked for one reversal and one corrected invoice (single invoice with PO attached and correct VAT).
lee-finance: @jon can you hold one of the captures open? If not, we'll process a refund and issue a corrected credit note + reissue invoice. Need to preserve accounting audit trail.
jon: stripe-cli logs indicate both charges were captured instantly. I cannot void capture at gateway level now. Plan: refund INV-2026-03B (the later one) and create a credit note. Then reissue single invoice that matches the PO and VAT. I'll run refunds once @lee-finance signs off.
lee-finance: approved. Please include reversal reason "Duplicate invoice due to PO-attach race at midnight batch" and tag finance_ref NX-312. Also, record VAT adjustments so our VAT liability reporting stays clean.
jon: running refund: `stripe refunds create --charge ch_1Jx...B --reason duplicate --metadata ticket=NX-2026-312,finance_ref=NX-312` — refund started, id rf_1Kz... Running cost reversal in accounting.
billing-bot: Refund rf_1Kz... processed for charge ch_1Jx...B, amount 1,240.00 EUR, fee adjustment pending. Event: refund.succeeded at 2009876578.
maria: letting customer know refund is in progress and we'll send corrected invoice. They asked ETA for credit hitting their bank. I told them 5-7 business days typical.
jon: created credit note CN-2026-03-NEB and new invoice INV-2026-03-REISSUE with PO attached and VAT 0% (confirmed exemption from their accountant). Marked as paid using original payment method placeholder and adjusted ledger.
lee-finance: please attach CN and final journal entries to NX-312. I'll run a reconciliation tomorrow and confirm tax reporting tags.
maria: customer acknowleged and appreciates fast handling. They requested we add guard to block simultaneous PO-attach+batch invoice for same subscription within 5s window. Could we add a server-side dedupe key?
jon: yes — proposed fix: when batch creates an invoice, write a short-lived key invoice:pending:<sub_id> with TTL 10s; PO-attach flow checks that key and defers if present. I'll raise a PR against billing-service and add a tiny migration.
sam: thanks all. @maria can you close NX-2026-312 once finance confirms reconciliation and customer verifies refund? :thumbsup: 
maria: will do, closing when finance confirms.
nebulax-support: thanks team — refund shows pending, we'll confirm once settled. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:
